chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: 469 Introduction Legal research skills, along with legal writing skills, are an essential component of the armoury of any law graduate.
text_raw:
469
Introduction
Legal research skills, along with legal writing skills, are an essential component of the 
armoury of any law graduate.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Reports on teaching law students have indicated that the qualities, skills and understandings, including research skills, developed during their tertiary education, as much as their subject-specific knowledge, determine whether a law student will be successful in the workplace.1 More immediately, a law student is hampered in their studies if they have not learned to carry out effective research.
text_raw:
Reports on teaching law students have indicated that 
the qualities, skills and understandings, including research skills, developed during their 
tertiary education, as much as their subject-specific knowledge, determine whether a law 
student will be successful in the workplace.1 More immediately, a law student is hampered 
in their studies if they have not learned to carry out effective research.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: This chapter covers: • why legal research skills are important and the kinds of skills needed; • the goals of legal research, and the constraints that limit the approach to take; • how to take a strategic approach to legal research, with a detailed focus on how to apply this approach to finding the current law as it applies to a particular scenario; and • where to find sources of legal information.
text_raw:
This chapter covers: 
• why legal research skills are important and the kinds of skills needed; 
• the goals of legal research, and the constraints that limit the approach to take; 
• how to take a strategic approach to legal research, with a detailed focus on how 
to apply this approach to finding the current law as it applies to a particular 
scenario; and 
• where to find sources of legal information.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Why legal research skills are important Law students and legal practitioners need to acquire good research capabilities because the law is complex and changing constantly.
text_raw:
Why legal research skills are important
Law students and legal practitioners need to acquire good research capabilities because the 
law is complex and changing constantly.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Knowing where to find new developments is the most useful knowledge a student obtains as part of their law studies.
text_raw:
Knowing where to find new developments is the 
most useful knowledge a student obtains as part of their law studies.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Daily, there are new cases and legislation; principles learned today can be obsolete tomorrow.
text_raw:
Daily, there are new 
cases and legislation; principles learned today can be obsolete tomorrow.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: It is, therefore, essential to anyone working with or writing about the law to be able to find the legal rules relevant to a particular problem or topic and to know that the rules are up to date.
text_raw:
It is, therefore, 
essential to anyone working with or writing about the law to be able to find the legal 
rules relevant to a particular problem or topic and to know that the rules are up to date.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: T o do so effectively requires the development of research strategies and an understanding of research process.
text_raw:
T o do so effectively requires the development of research strategies and an understanding 
of research process.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The need to develop good research skills is also a function of the rapid changes in information technology and resources.2 The information revolution, in conjunction with the process of globalisation, has increased our access to information and, in many fields, leads to greater harmonisation of rules in different legal systems.
text_raw:
The need to develop good research skills is also a function of the rapid changes in 
information technology and resources.2 The information revolution, in conjunction with 
the process of globalisation, has increased our access to information and, in many fields, 
leads to greater harmonisation of rules in different legal systems.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: An Australian lawyer who cannot keep up to date with legal trends as they develop around the world is at risk of being placed at a significant disadvantage against professional colleagues.
text_raw:
An Australian lawyer 
who cannot keep up to date with legal trends as they develop around the world is at risk 
of being placed at a significant disadvantage against professional colleagues.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: This being the case, it is no solace to be told that legal research is one of the more challenging aspects of a lawyer’s work.
text_raw:
This being the case, it is no solace to be told that legal research is one of the more 
challenging aspects of a lawyer’s work.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Lawyers are seldom asked a straightforward legal question by a client.
text_raw:
Lawyers are seldom asked a straightforward legal 
question by a client.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Instead, a client presents a set of facts to the lawyer, whose job is then to clarify those facts, identify whether they present a legal issue, find the relevant law, and present a conclusion or advice about how the law applies to those facts.
text_raw:
Instead, a client presents a set of facts to the lawyer, whose job is then 
to clarify those facts, identify whether they present a legal issue, find the relevant law, and 
present a conclusion or advice about how the law applies to those facts.

text: The successful researcher needs a range of skills and qualities.

text: This chapter outlines the tasks a researcher needs to complete to ensure the research is thorough and effective.
text_raw:
This chapter outlines the

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Specific research skills for finding particular types of legal resources are discussed in Chapters 17–19.
text_raw:
Specific research skills for finding particular types of legal resources are discussed in

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Those new to using legal resources will reap later rewards if they take the time to evaluate these resources, identifying those most useful for particular areas of law or a particular legal research task.
text_raw:
Those new to using legal resources will reap later rewards if they take 
the time to evaluate these resources, identifying those most useful for particular areas of 
law or a particular legal research task.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Acquiring these skills involves development of research strategies.
text_raw: Acquiring these skills involves development of research strategies.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: This chapter also deals with strategies for finding the current law as it applies to a particular problem scenario, as answering problem questions is an important task that all law students will be required to undertake from the beginning of their studies.
text_raw:
This chapter also 
deals with strategies for finding the current law as it applies to a particular problem 
scenario, as answering problem questions is an important task that all law students will be 
required to undertake from the beginning of their studies.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Researching for legal essays or law reform assignments might require more focus on secondary materials of academic scholarship and policy documents, but a researcher will always need to be able to find the current law.
text_raw:
Researching for legal essays 
or law reform assignments might require more focus on secondary materials of academic 
scholarship and policy documents, but a researcher will always need to be able to find the 
current law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Goals and constraints There are several different legal research tasks.
text_raw:
Goals and constraints
There are several different legal research tasks.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: All may be simulated during a law course.
text_raw: All may be simulated during a law course.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The nature of the research task varies with the intended goal.
text_raw: The nature of the research task varies with the intended goal.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Advising a client on a matter requires reference to the law current in the state or territory in which the person resides or works.
text_raw:
Advising a client on a matter 
requires reference to the law current in the state or territory in which the person resides 
or works.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Such research is likely to have a narrower focus than the research required for an appeal to the High Court which, if successful, may change the law.
text_raw:
Such research is likely to have a narrower focus than the research required 
for an appeal to the High Court which, if successful, may change the law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: A law reform assignment throws the net wider, often to include the law throughout Australia or beyond its shores, while a legal academic, critiquing the existing law, often needs to engage in research which is more open-ended, exploring empirical, theoretical and policy research, in order to suggest alternative solutions.
text_raw:
A law reform 
assignment throws the net wider, often to include the law throughout Australia or beyond 
its shores, while a legal academic, critiquing the existing law, often needs to engage in 
research which is more open-ended, exploring empirical, theoretical and policy research, 
in order to suggest alternative solutions.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The structure and direction of the research task will also, in practice, be determined by resource constraints.
text_raw:
The structure and direction of the research task will also, in practice, be determined 
by resource constraints.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Time and financial constraints for a client will influence how much research can be undertaken for a particular matter.
text_raw:
Time and financial constraints for a client will influence how 
much research can be undertaken for a particular matter.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The research should always be direct and disciplined, but especially so for a tight deadline or a minor matter.
text_raw:
The research should always 
be direct and disciplined, but especially so for a tight deadline or a minor matter.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: If the issue arises in an appeal where the hearing is months away, the research may be more extensive and free-ranging.
text_raw:
If the issue arises in an appeal where the hearing is months away, the research may be 
more extensive and free-ranging.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: A small commercial dispute will not warrant as much research as a complex legal issue, or one that has significant implications and for which the client is willing to extend the time and cost involved.
text_raw:
A small commercial dispute will not warrant as much 
research as a complex legal issue, or one that has significant implications and for which 
the client is willing to extend the time and cost involved.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: For an issue where the client is a multinational company and millions of dollars are at stake, engaging a team of legal researchers may be warranted.
text_raw:
For an issue where the client 
is a multinational company and millions of dollars are at stake, engaging a team of legal 
researchers may be warranted.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Law students similarly face constraints and need to assess how much research is warranted for any particular exercise.
text_raw:
Law students similarly face constraints and need to assess how much research is 
warranted for any particular exercise.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Factors relevant to students are the length and assessment weight of the particular assignment, the need to allow enough time for analysing and writing up the research, and competing study demands such as other assignments and ongoing class preparation.
text_raw:
Factors relevant to students are the length and 
assessment weight of the particular assignment, the need to allow enough time for analysing 
and writing up the research, and competing study demands such as other assignments and 
ongoing class preparation.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Different kinds of legal research will call for different approaches.
text_raw: Different kinds of legal research will call for different approaches.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: But legal research of all varieties will require information literacy.
text_raw:

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: LAYING DOWN THE LAW 474 In many legal problems, the actors have special characteristics that are legally relevant.
text_raw:
LAYING DOWN THE LAW
474
In many legal problems, the actors have special characteristics that are legally relevant.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: An actor may be of a particular type or class, such as a medical practitioner.
text_raw: An actor may be of a particular type or class, such as a medical practitioner.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: They may have special legal status, such as a child, a bankrupt or a person with diplomatic immunity.
text_raw:
They may 
have special legal status, such as a child, a bankrupt or a person with diplomatic immunity.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: They may be involved in a legally relevant relationship, such as trustee and beneficiary; employer and employee; company and shareholder; business partners; husband and wife; or parent and child.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: R — Remedy or relief This aspect of the facts corresponds with harm, discussed above.
text_raw:
R — Remedy or relief
This aspect of the facts corresponds with harm, discussed above.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The lawyer should consider the various ways in which the harm may be addressed, and what the parties’ preferences are in this connection.
text_raw:
The lawyer should 
consider the various ways in which the harm may be addressed, and what the parties’ 
preferences are in this connection.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Often the law will prescribe and limit the types of remedies that a court can order for a particular harm.
text_raw:
Often the law will prescribe and limit the types of 
remedies that a court can order for a particular harm.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: In civil actions the most common remedy is monetary compensation, known as damages.
text_raw:
In civil actions the most common remedy is monetary compensation, known as 
damages.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: However, depending on the nature of the case, there may be alternatives that should be considered.
text_raw:
However, depending on the nature of the case, there may be alternatives that 
should be considered.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: If the client is a purchaser complaining that the seller will not fulfil their side of the bargain, the lawyer should find out whether the client would prefer damages or for the sale to be carried through.
text_raw:
If the client is a purchaser complaining that the seller will not fulfil 
their side of the bargain, the lawyer should find out whether the client would prefer 
damages or for the sale to be carried through.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: If the client is a landowner complaining about a nearby nuisance, the lawyer should ask whether the person would prefer the nuisance to cease or monetary compensation, or both.
text_raw:
If the client is a landowner complaining 
about a nearby nuisance, the lawyer should ask whether the person would prefer the 
nuisance to cease or monetary compensation, or both.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: A further consideration is the client’s attitude to delay and uncertainty.
text_raw:
A further consideration is the 
client’s attitude to delay and uncertainty.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Would a prompt settlement for a lesser sum be preferable to the uncertain promise of a greater sum at a later date?
text_raw:
Would a prompt settlement for a lesser sum 
be preferable to the uncertain promise of a greater sum at a later date?

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Finally, in many commercial and domestic matters, it is often necessary to assess the relationship between the parties.
text_raw:
Finally, in many 
commercial and domestic matters, it is often necessary to assess the relationship between 
the parties.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Depending on the path the dispute takes, the relationship may be damaged; it will be important to be aware of this, and take necessary steps in mitigation.
text_raw:
Depending on the path the dispute takes, the relationship may be damaged; it 
will be important to be aware of this, and take necessary steps in mitigation.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: Similar questions should be asked in criminal cases.
text_raw: Similar questions should be asked in criminal cases.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The prosecutor’s view of an appropriate penalty will be based on the views of the victim and the broader interests of the community.
text_raw:
The prosecutor’s view of an 
appropriate penalty will be based on the views of the victim and the broader interests 
of the community.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The defence lawyer should determine the defendant’s attitude to the various penalty options and the other possible consequences of a conviction.
text_raw:
The defence lawyer should determine the defendant’s attitude to the 
various penalty options and the other possible consequences of a conviction.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: As with civil cases, uncertainty and delay should also be considered.
text_raw:
As with civil 
cases, uncertainty and delay should also be considered.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: A prosecutor and defendant may agree to a guilty plea for a lesser offence to avoid, on the prosecution side, the risk of an acquittal, and on the defence side, the risk of a conviction for a more serious offence.
text_raw:
A prosecutor and defendant may 
agree to a guilty plea for a lesser offence to avoid, on the prosecution side, the risk of an 
acquittal, and on the defence side, the risk of a conviction for a more serious offence.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: An early guilty plea also saves resources, stress and trauma on both sides.
text_raw:
An 
early guilty plea also saves resources, stress and trauma on both sides.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: P — Policy considerations The content and application of the law is often heavily influenced by broader policy concerns.
text_raw:
P — Policy considerations
The content and application of the law is often heavily influenced by broader policy 
concerns.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The final letter in the SHARP approach to factual analysis reminds the legal researcher to be alert not only to facts that are material in the purely legal sense, but also to facts that resonate at the policy level.
text_raw:
The final letter in the SHARP approach to factual analysis reminds the legal 
researcher to be alert not only to facts that are material in the purely legal sense, but also 
to facts that resonate at the policy level.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: A good personal-injury lawyer will be aware of widespread concern over the increasing costs of litigation; calls for greater individual responsibility, for example, through rehabilitation; and more efficient methods of resolving disputes such as by means of appropriate or alternative dispute resolution processes.
text_raw:
A good personal-injury lawyer will be aware 
of widespread concern over the increasing costs of litigation; calls for greater individual 
responsibility, for example, through rehabilitation; and more efficient methods of resolving 
disputes such as by means of appropriate or alternative dispute resolution processes.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs

An 
effective criminal lawyer will be aware of prevailing attitudes to ‘law and order’, the actual

text_raw:
The magpie was electrocuted, causing 
a surge of power through the transformer, and 1200  volts were transmitted to the

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs

Tom seeks 
compensation of $5,000 from the electricity provider for the damage done to his 
freezer and the consequent loss of the food.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: This situation may be analysed by applying the SHARP factors.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: The situation (S) in this example involves a wild magpie’s nest on an electricity pole owned by an electricity authority, a power surge caused by the magpie, and consequent property damage suffered by a consumer of electricity.

The situation (S) 
in this example involves a wild magpie’s nest on an electricity pole owned by an electricity

Consider which facts in this situation may be relevant or 
not relevant.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 16 LEgAL REsEARCH — APPRo ACHEs And sTEPs
text: For example, the fact that the surge was caused by an animal rather than an employee of the authority is relevant, and that the animal was wild, rather than a pet (for whom someone might be responsible), but it is not relevant that the bird was a magpie rather than a myna or a sparrow.

equipment was also damaged, and whether he had any consequential losses.

The policy

CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Introduction It was mentioned in the previous chapter that a law student who is information literate has the ability to use appropriate research tools to efficiently and effectively locate primary and secondary sources of law: see 16.7.
text_raw:
Introduction
It was mentioned in the previous chapter that a law student who is information literate 
has the ability to use appropriate research tools to efficiently and effectively locate primary 
and secondary sources of law: see  16.7.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Primary sources of law are cases and legislation that state the law, and we will discuss finding these sources in Chapters 18 and 19 respectively.
text_raw:
Primary sources of law are cases and legislation 
that state the law, and we will discuss finding these sources in Chapters  18 and 19 
respectively.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: In this chapter, we focus on secondary sources of law — the materials that describe the law and provide commentary about the law, including: • textbooks; • legal dictionaries; • legal encyclopedias; • journal articles; and • other sources of commentary.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Some of these sources are available both online and in print.
text_raw: Some of these sources are available both online and in print.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Because most legal research is now conducted online, and modern university libraries prioritise online resources over print material, our focus is on finding secondary sources of law online.
text_raw:
Because most legal 
research is now conducted online, and modern university libraries prioritise online 
resources over print material, our focus is on finding secondary sources of law online.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The chapter begins with an analysis of some strategies and steps to consider when researching secondary sources of law.
text_raw:
The chapter begins with an analysis of some strategies and steps to consider when 
researching secondary sources of law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This is followed by an overview of online research tools and a section on how to undertake online legal research, which includes a detailed discussion about Boolean searching.
text_raw:
This is followed by an overview of online research 
tools and a section on how to undertake online legal research, which includes a detailed 
discussion about Boolean searching.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Boolean search strategy is applicable to the databases discussed in this chapter as well as those referred to in the following chapters on finding case law and legislation.
text_raw:
Boolean search strategy is applicable to the databases 
discussed in this chapter as well as those referred to in the following chapters on finding 
case law and legislation.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Finally, there is a detailed discussion of all of the major secondary sources of law, and the online research tools that can be used to find them.
text_raw:
Finally, there is a detailed discussion of all of the major secondary 
sources of law, and the online research tools that can be used to find them.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Strategies and steps When looking for information on a legal topic or principle, it is wise to start by consulting secondary sources, to get an overview, before delving into the detail of primary materials.
text_raw:
Strategies and steps
When looking for information on a legal topic or principle, it is wise to start by consulting 
secondary sources, to get an overview, before delving into the detail of primary materials.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This will enable the researcher to place the issue involved in its broader legal context and will often alert them to areas of uncertainty and controversy in the law.
text_raw:
This will enable the researcher to place the issue involved in its broader legal context 
and will often alert them to areas of uncertainty and controversy in the law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: A secondary source will also refer to key case law or legislation that is relevant for the next stage of the research.
text_raw:
A secondary 
source will also refer to key case law or legislation that is relevant for the next stage of 
the research.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Approaching the task this way reduces the risk of being overwhelmed by the detail in primary sources.
text_raw:
Approaching the task this way reduces the risk of being overwhelmed by the 
detail in primary sources.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Depending on the prior knowledge of the researcher, finding secondary sources of law may involve a two-stage process.
text_raw:
Depending on the prior knowledge of the researcher, finding secondary sources of 
law may involve a two-stage process.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: First, to obtain an overview of the relevant law, the researcher can start by consulting relevant textbooks, legal dictionaries and encyclopedias.
text_raw:
First, to obtain an overview of the relevant law, the 
researcher can start by consulting relevant textbooks, legal dictionaries and encyclopedias.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Then, if the researcher is expected to critique the law, this can be followed by an examination of relevant journal articles and other commentary.
text_raw:
Then, if the researcher is expected to critique the law, this can be followed by an 
examination of relevant journal articles and other commentary.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This two-step process reflects the different perspectives in secondary sources.
text_raw:
This two-step process 
reflects the different perspectives in secondary sources.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Some sources, such as textbooks and legal encyclopedias, are usually written in an objective style, describing what the law says and how it operates.
text_raw:
Some sources, such as textbooks 
and legal encyclopedias, are usually written in an objective style, describing what the 
law says and how it operates.

text: The first step — a review of relevant textbooks, legal dictionaries and encyclopedias, and perhaps other secondary sources such as law reform or parliamentary reports — will provide a general understanding of the origin and development of the pertinent legal principles.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The researcher will then be in a position to carry out more detailed research as the second step: searching for and identifying journal articles and other commentary that discuss those legal principles, often comparing them with the historical principles on the topic, or that discuss relevant principles from other jurisdictions.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Having carried out these two steps, the researcher will have identified and formed an understanding of the contentious issues in the primary legal sources.
text_raw:
Having carried out 
these two steps, the researcher will have identified and formed an understanding of the 
contentious issues in the primary legal sources.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This puts them in a good position to then delve into the primary sources, if necessary.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Primary and secondary sources of law can also be searched by law students via their university library’s search engine.
text_raw:
Primary and secondary sources of law can also be searched by law students via their 
university library’s search engine.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: These ‘one-stop-shop’ discovery tools are designed to trawl all of the databases subscribed to by the library in a single search.
text_raw:
These ‘one-stop-shop’ discovery tools are designed to 
trawl all of the databases subscribed to by the library in a single search.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: However, many legal publishers do not make it possible to discover their resources via these search engines, particularly primary sources of law.

However, many 
legal publishers do not make it possible to discover their resources via these search engines,

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It also needs to be recognised that law students may not have access to such a tool once they start practising law, so it is best to learn how to use each individual online legal research tool.

text: Ho W To undERTAKE onLinE LEgAL RESEARCH Fortunately, from the user’s point of view, there are many similarities in how the various legal databases operate.

Fortunately, from the user’s point of view, there are many similarities in how the various 
legal databases operate.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: A common feature of many databases is the ability to perform ‘free text searching’ (also known as ‘full text searching’).
text_raw:
A common feature of many databases is the ability to perform ‘free 
text searching’ (also known as ‘full text searching’).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: For example, a database may allow the full text of a set of journals, a specified journal, or a single article, to be searched for a particular word or legal phrase, or for references to a particular case or legislative instrument.
text_raw:
For example, a database may allow 
the full text of a set of journals, a specified journal, or a single article, to be searched for a 
particular word or legal phrase, or for references to a particular case or legislative instrument.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: However, there are also important differences between databases.
text_raw: However, there are also important differences between databases.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: For example, some databases only provide references to (or summaries of) secondary sources of law and do not provide access to full text documents.
text_raw:
For example, some 
databases only provide references to (or summaries of) secondary sources of law and do 
not provide access to full text documents.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: These databases are known as bibliographic databases (or index databases).
text_raw:
These databases are known as bibliographic 
databases (or index databases).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: For example, a library catalogue or library search engine does not allow searching for key words across the full text of all of the books in that library’s collection.
text_raw:
For example, a library catalogue or library search 
engine does not allow searching for key words across the full text of all of the books in 
that library’s collection.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Instead, the researcher is searching for key words only within the bibliographic records that have been created by the library for each book.
text_raw:
Instead, the researcher is searching for key words only within the 
bibliographic records that have been created by the library for each book.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Perseverance is often required for achieving useful research outcomes, particularly when searching for key words and phrases across the full text of documents.
text_raw:
Perseverance is often required for achieving useful research outcomes, particularly 
when searching for key words and phrases across the full text of documents.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This may involve the researcher trying a different search strategy, such as using alternative search terms, when an initial search has been unproductive.
text_raw:
This may 
involve the researcher trying a different search strategy, such as using alternative search 
terms, when an initial search has been unproductive.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: A common form of searching to assist with this process is known as ‘Boolean searching’.
text_raw:
A common form of searching to 
assist with this process is known as ‘Boolean searching’.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: BooLEAn SEARCHing Boolean searching is the most commonly employed technique for online searching.
text_raw:
BooLEAn SEARCHing
Boolean searching is the most commonly employed technique for online searching.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Named after George Boole, an English mathematician, Boolean logic enables a researcher to combine concepts or exclude others.
text_raw:
Named after George Boole, an English mathematician, Boolean logic enables a researcher 
to combine concepts or exclude others.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It gives the researcher control, but also requires a degree of skill and knowledge.
text_raw:
It gives the researcher control, but also requires 
a degree of skill and knowledge.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Boolean searching attempts to find the balance between doing a search that may be too broad (potentially yielding too many irrelevant results) and a search that may be too narrow (potentially missing relevant results).
text_raw:
Boolean searching attempts to find the balance between 
doing a search that may be too broad (potentially yielding too many irrelevant results) and 
a search that may be too narrow (potentially missing relevant results).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Practice will enable you to use Boolean searching effectively.

Practice will enable 
you to use Boolean searching effectively.

text: 490 LAYING DOWN THE LAW In a Boolean search, the researcher must anticipate word choices that might have been used by the authors of the documents being sought.
text_raw:
490
LAYING DOWN THE LAW
In a Boolean search, the researcher must anticipate word choices that might have 
been used by the authors of the documents being sought.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This form of searching can be particularly valuable if you have partial recall of the information you are seeking, especially if that information is somehow unique or specific.
text_raw:
This form of searching can be 
particularly valuable if you have partial recall of the information you are seeking, especially 
if that information is somehow unique or specific.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: For example, if you remember that the Chief Justice of Victoria had once referred to a ‘tiger’ in connection with tribunals and you searched using ‘tiger’ and ‘Chief Justice of Victoria’, you would be rewarded with a paper by the Chief Justice in which, as the Law Institute of Victoria reported, the Chief Justice called administrative tribunals ‘a tiger ready to pounce on the power and influence of traditional courts.’ Boolean searching involves the combination of two components: ‘search terms’ and ‘search operators’.
text_raw:
For example, if you remember that 
the Chief Justice of Victoria had once referred to a ‘tiger’ in connection with tribunals 
and you searched using ‘tiger’ and ‘Chief Justice of Victoria’, you would be rewarded 
with a paper by the Chief Justice in which, as the Law Institute of Victoria reported, the 
Chief Justice called administrative tribunals ‘a tiger ready to pounce on the power and 
influence of traditional courts.’
Boolean searching involves the combination of two components: ‘search terms’ and 
‘search operators’.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: A search term is the term or expression that the researcher is trying to locate.
text_raw:
A search term is the term or expression that the researcher is trying to 
locate.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: For example, a personal injury lawyer may use search terms such as ‘negligence’, ‘duty of care’, ‘personal injury’ and ‘pain and suffering’.
text_raw:
For example, a personal injury lawyer may use search terms such as ‘negligence’, 
‘duty of care’, ‘personal injury’ and ‘pain and suffering’.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: A search operator (or connector) is a means of connecting different search terms so as to provide a means of refining a search.
text_raw:
A search operator (or connector) 
is a means of connecting different search terms so as to provide a means of refining a 
search.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Search software may use slightly different Boolean operators and if this is the case they are usually specified on the website.
text_raw:
Search software may use slightly different Boolean operators and if this is the case 
they are usually specified on the website.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The most commonly used search operators are AND, OR, and NOT, sometimes used with proximity operators and wildcards.
text_raw:
The most commonly used search operators are 
AND, OR, and NOT, sometimes used with proximity operators and wildcards.

text: AND:
text_raw: AND:

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The ‘AND’ operator will return all of the documents containing two or more search terms but excludes those that only contain one of the terms.
text_raw:
The ‘AND’ operator will return all of the documents containing two or 
more search terms but excludes those that only contain one of the terms.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This effectively narrows the search.
text_raw: This effectively narrows the search.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: For example, in searching for murder cases in which provocation was used as a defence, a researcher could search for <murder AND provocation> to narrow the murder cases down to those that also contained the term provocation.
text_raw:
For example, in searching for murder 
cases in which provocation was used as a defence, a researcher could search 
for <murder AND provocation> to narrow the murder cases down to those 
that also contained the term provocation.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES

text_raw:
For

causes of unfair dismissal.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: These operators allow you to search for documents that contain two terms but specify that you only want those documents where the two terms are located near each other.
text_raw:
These operators allow you to search for documents 
that contain two terms but specify that you only want those documents where 
the two terms are located near each other.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Where the second term needs to be within a certain number of words of the first term, ‘w/n’ is placed between the two terms, where the n is the specified number of words.
text_raw:
Where the second term needs to be 
within a certain number of words of the first term, ‘w/n’ is placed between 
the two terms, where the n is the specified number of words.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Alternatively, the second term could be within the same sentence (‘w/s’) or the same paragraph (‘w/p’).
text_raw:
Alternatively, 
the second term could be within the same sentence (‘w/s’) or the same 
paragraph (‘w/p’).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: For example, a search for <negligence w/10 doctor> would instruct the search engine to find only those documents that contain these two search terms within 10 words of each other.
text_raw:
For example, a search for <negligence w/10 doctor> would 
instruct the search engine to find only those documents that contain these 
two search terms within 10 words of each other.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Proximity operators can be a very effective tool to eliminate potentially irrelevant results, particularly when searching lengthy documents in full text databases.

Proximity operators can be a very effective tool to eliminate potentially 
irrelevant results, particularly when searching lengthy documents in full text 
databases.

text: The most common wildcards are: * In some databases an asterisk ‘*’ substitutes for any number of letters or numerals and is used at the end of a word.

The most common wildcards are:
* In some databases an asterisk ‘*’ substitutes for any number of letters or

?

text_raw:
Generally speaking, certain commonly occurring words either cannot be used 
as search terms or will be ignored by most search engines.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: These tend to be articles and prepositions such as ‘the’ and ‘of’, often referred to as ‘stop words’.
text_raw:

and prepositions such as ‘the’ and ‘of’, often referred to as ‘stop words’.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Similarly, search operators generally cannot be used as search terms.

Similarly, search 
operators generally cannot be used as search terms.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Some research systems, however, do allow common words to be searched.
text_raw:
Some research systems, however, do 
allow common words to be searched.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It is therefore a good idea to use capital letters for the search operators as this may prevent the database treating the search operator as a search term.

the search operators as this may prevent the database treating the search operator as a

CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Textbooks A logical starting point for law students to commence their research on a legal topic is to consult the prescribed and recommended textbooks referred to in the subject guide of their course.
text_raw:
Textbooks
A logical starting point for law students to commence their research on a legal topic is to 
consult the prescribed and recommended textbooks referred to in the subject guide of 
their course.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: T extbooks not only serve the purpose of presenting the researcher with an overview of a legal topic but they also refer to key primary sources of law, such as relevant cases and legislation.
text_raw:
T extbooks not only serve the purpose of presenting the researcher with an 
overview of a legal topic but they also refer to key primary sources of law, such as relevant 
cases and legislation.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Some textbooks also provide detailed extracts from important cases on the topic.
text_raw:
Some textbooks also provide detailed extracts from important cases 
on the topic.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This is useful for the researcher because it allows them to quickly pinpoint the most important parts of a judgment.
text_raw:
This is useful for the researcher because it allows them to quickly pinpoint 
the most important parts of a judgment.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: These types of textbooks are sometimes referred to as casebooks and will often have the phrase ‘Cases and Materials’ or ‘Commentary and Materials’ as part of their title.
text_raw:
These types of textbooks are sometimes referred 
to as casebooks and will often have the phrase ‘Cases and Materials’ or ‘Commentary and 
Materials’ as part of their title.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Occasionally seminal texts, despite being secondary sources, have been deemed authoritative of the law.
text_raw:
Occasionally seminal texts, despite being secondary sources, have been deemed 
authoritative of the law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Blackstone’s Commentaries, which was discussed at 1.27, is one example.
text_raw:
Blackstone’s Commentaries, which was discussed at 1.27, is one 
example.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The judgments of the High Court in Mabo v Queensland [No 2]3 show Blackstone’s description of the 18 th-century common law was accepted as de facto determinative: see 4.4.
text_raw:
The judgments of the High Court in Mabo v Queensland [No 2]3 show Blackstone’s 
description of the 18 th-century common law was accepted as de facto determinative: 
see  4.4.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: In most cases, however, a secondary source will be accepted only as the author’s view of the law, although some texts are recognised as more authoritative than others.
text_raw:
In most cases, however, a secondary source will be accepted only as the author’s 
view of the law, although some texts are recognised as more authoritative than others.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Accordingly, after having consulted one or more textbooks or casebooks, the next step is to read and evaluate the cases and legislation identified, to see whether they are current and relevant and how they might be used to assist with your analysis (as discussed in Chapters 18 and 19).
text_raw:
Accordingly, after having consulted one or more textbooks or casebooks, the next step is 
to read and evaluate the cases and legislation identified, to see whether they are current 
and relevant and how they might be used to assist with your analysis (as discussed in 
Chapters 18 and 19).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: T extbooks have traditionally been available in print form only.
text_raw: T extbooks have traditionally been available in print form only.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: However, this has changed, with many textbooks now also available as ebooks.
text_raw:
However, this has 
changed, with many textbooks now also available as ebooks.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Some textbooks can only be purchased in ebook format by individuals rather than libraries.
text_raw:
Some textbooks can only 
be purchased in ebook format by individuals rather than libraries.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: However, whole collections of ebooks are now also being made available to libraries by many legal publishers.
text_raw:
However, whole 
collections of ebooks are now also being made available to libraries by many legal 
publishers.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Regardless of format, the most straightforward way for law students to find relevant legal textbooks is to use the catalogue or search engine of their university library.
text_raw:
Regardless of format, the most straightforward way for law students to find 
relevant legal textbooks is to use the catalogue or search engine of their university library.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The search will provide a link to electronic access or, if this is not available, the exact location of a print copy of the book in the library.
text_raw:
The search will provide a link to electronic access or, if this is not available, the exact 
location of a print copy of the book in the library.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Legal dictionaries Sometimes a researcher may know little about a particular legal topic and will come across words and phrases that they do not know the meaning of, and where it would be useful to obtain a succinct definition.
text_raw:
Legal dictionaries
Sometimes a researcher may know little about a particular legal topic and will come 
across words and phrases that they do not know the meaning of, and where it would 
be useful to obtain a succinct definition.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: On other occasions a researcher is confronted with a legal term written in Latin.
text_raw:
On other occasions a researcher is confronted 
with a legal term written in Latin.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Legal dictionaries are a useful resource, particularly as a starting point, for all of these scenarios.
text_raw:
Legal dictionaries are a useful resource, particularly as 
a starting point, for all of these scenarios.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: In addition to providing a definition of a legal word or phrase, the dictionary may also refer to case law and legislation defining the term.
text_raw:
In addition to providing a definition of a legal 
word or phrase, the dictionary may also refer to case law and legislation defining the term.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: University libraries will sometimes have print versions of a variety of legal dictionaries in their collection.
text_raw:
University libraries will sometimes have print versions of a variety of legal dictionaries 
in their collection.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Some leading legal dictionaries are also available online, including the Australian Law Dictionary by Oxford University Press.
text_raw:
Some leading legal dictionaries are also available online, including 
the Australian Law Dictionary by Oxford University Press.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The Lexis Advance platform contains two other useful online resources for obtaining definitions of legal words and phrases.
text_raw:
The Lexis Advance platform 
contains two other useful online resources for obtaining definitions of legal words and 
phrases.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The Encyclopaedic Australian Legal Dictionary has over 25,000 definitions covering every subject area of law, with terms and definitions presented in an Australian context.
text_raw:
The Encyclopaedic Australian Legal Dictionary has over 25,000 definitions covering 
every subject area of law, with terms and definitions presented in an Australian context.

496

Australian Legal Words and Phrases contains over 100,000 words and phrases defined in

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Legal encyclopedias A legal encyclopedia may be consulted to identify the key legal principles, and for a comprehensive list of primary sources — both legislation and case law — on a topic.
text_raw:
Legal encyclopedias
A legal encyclopedia may be consulted to identify the key legal principles, and for a 
comprehensive list of primary sources — both legislation and case law — on a topic.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Like a textbook, a legal encyclopedia provides an outline of the main principles of law and may give some historical background and point to yet to be settled areas of the law.
text_raw:
Like 
a textbook, a legal encyclopedia provides an outline of the main principles of law and may 
give some historical background and point to yet to be settled areas of the law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: References may also be given to other secondary sources of law that provide further commentary on the topic being researched.
text_raw:
References 
may also be given to other secondary sources of law that provide further commentary on 
the topic being researched.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Generally, legal encyclopedias are written in a propositional style, which clearly sets out the principles and issues, and aim to be an objective statement of the information provided.
text_raw:
Generally, legal encyclopedias are written in a propositional 
style, which clearly sets out the principles and issues, and aim to be an objective statement 
of the information provided.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Australian researchers are fortunate to have access to two Australian legal encyclopedias — Halsbury’s Laws of Australia and The Laws of Australia.
text_raw:
Australian researchers are fortunate to have access to two Australian legal 
encyclopedias  — Halsbury’s Laws of Australia and The Laws of Australia.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Prior to the publication of these sources, Australian researchers relied on Halsbury’s Laws of England for any comprehensive coverage of a legal topic.
text_raw:
Prior to the 
publication of these sources, Australian researchers relied on Halsbury’s Laws of England 
for any comprehensive coverage of a legal topic.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Given the increasing divergence of laws in the two legal systems, Halsbury’s Laws of England has become less useful to Australians.
text_raw:
Given the increasing divergence of laws 
in the two legal systems, Halsbury’s Laws of England has become less useful to Australians.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: However, reference to the English Halsbury’s may sometimes still be necessary if the researcher is undertaking historical research, or research in an area of the law in which Australian law has not departed from its English roots.
text_raw:
However, reference to the English Halsbury’s may sometimes still be necessary if the 
researcher is undertaking historical research, or research in an area of the law in which 
Australian law has not departed from its English roots.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: All of these legal encyclopedias are available in print format but are more commonly accessed online.
text_raw:
All of these legal encyclopedias are available in print format but are more commonly 
accessed online.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Halsbury’s Laws of Australia (and Halsbury’s Laws of England) can be accessed via Lexis Advance and The Laws of Australia is available via Westlaw AU.
text_raw:
Halsbury’s Laws of Australia (and Halsbury’s Laws of England) can be accessed 
via Lexis Advance and The Laws of Australia is available via Westlaw AU.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: HALSBuRy’S LAWS of A uSTRALiA Halsbury’s Laws of Australia (via Lexis Advance) is a comprehensive legal encyclopedia providing definitive statements of Australian law across a total of 90 subject areas (each with their own title and title number).
text_raw:
HALSBuRy’S LAWS of A uSTRALiA 
Halsbury’s Laws of Australia (via Lexis Advance) is a comprehensive legal encyclopedia 
providing definitive statements of Australian law across a total of 90 subject areas (each 
with their own title and title number).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Information appears in numbered paragraphs within each title, and relevant cases and legislation are referred to in footnotes at the end of each paragraph.
text_raw:
Information appears in numbered paragraphs 
within each title, and relevant cases and legislation are referred to in footnotes at the end 
of each paragraph.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Halsbury’s Laws of Australia is updated regularly and, importantly, each paragraph has a currency date.
text_raw:
Halsbury’s Laws of Australia is updated regularly and, importantly, each 
paragraph has a currency date.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It is possible to either browse or search Halsbury’s Laws of Australia on Lexis Advance.
text_raw: It is possible to either browse or search Halsbury’s Laws of Australia on Lexis Advance.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Browsing involves going to the Halsbury’s Laws of Australia Table of Contents and selecting a subject title, then using the arrows to drill down into more specific subtitles.
text_raw:
Browsing involves going to the Halsbury’s Laws of Australia Table of Contents and selecting 
a subject title, then using the arrows to drill down into more specific subtitles.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Searching is best performed using the ‘Advanced Search’ feature and performing a Boolean search in the ‘T erms’ box (or any of the other available search fields).
text_raw:
Searching 
is best performed using the ‘Advanced Search’ feature and performing a Boolean search 
in the ‘T erms’ box (or any of the other available search fields).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Westlaw (sometimes called Thomson Reuters Westlaw or Westlaw International) is the international legal platform for Thomson Reuters and it also has a very large collection of journals from multiple jurisdictions.
text_raw:
Westlaw (sometimes called Thomson Reuters Westlaw or Westlaw International) is the 
international legal platform for Thomson Reuters and it also has a very large collection 
of journals from multiple jurisdictions.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Journals for individual countries can be searched by clicking on the ‘International Materials’ link on the Westlaw home page then going to the ‘World Journals’ link on the right-hand side of the page.
text_raw:
Journals for individual countries can be searched 
by clicking on the ‘International Materials’ link on the Westlaw home page then going to 
the ‘World Journals’ link on the right-hand side of the page.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It is possible to do a Boolean search across all jurisdictions in the one search from the ‘World Journals’ page.
text_raw:
It is possible to do a Boolean 
search across all jurisdictions in the one search from the ‘World Journals’ page.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Westlaw also provides access to Current Index to Legal Periodicals, which indexes articles from over 300 journals, including very recent articles.
text_raw:
Westlaw 
also provides access to Current Index to Legal Periodicals, which indexes articles from over 
300 journals, including very recent articles.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Another very important collection of international journals can be found on Hein Online.
text_raw:
Another very important collection of international journals can be found on 
Hein Online.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Its ‘Law Journal Library’ provides full-text access to over 2,800 law and law- related journals.
text_raw:
Its ‘Law Journal Library’ provides full-text access to over 2,800 law and law-
related journals.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The Advanced Search function allows Boolean searching across all of the available titles or selected titles.
text_raw:
The Advanced Search function allows Boolean searching across all of the 
available titles or selected titles.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Hein Online also has a number of other digital collections of secondary sources of law, as well as providing access to Index to Foreign Legal Periodicals, an index to over 500 international legal journals.
text_raw:
Hein Online also has a number of other digital collections 
of secondary sources of law, as well as providing access to Index to Foreign Legal Periodicals, 
an index to over 500 international legal journals.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Lexis Advance also has an extensive collection of journals from the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and other jurisdictions.
text_raw:
Lexis Advance also has an extensive collection of journals from the United States, 
United Kingdom, Canada and other jurisdictions.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Select the ‘Advanced Search’ option above the main red search box on the Lexis Advance home page and choose ‘Secondary Materials’.
text_raw:
Select the ‘Advanced Search’ option 
above the main red search box on the Lexis Advance home page and choose ‘Secondary 
Materials’.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Search results can then be sorted by jurisdiction and publication.
text_raw: Search results can then be sorted by jurisdiction and publication.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: LegalTrac, published by Gale, is a highly comprehensive international journal index of more than 1,200 major law reviews, legal newspapers, specialty publications, bar association journals and international legal journals.
text_raw:
LegalTrac, published by Gale, is a highly comprehensive international journal 
index of more than 1,200 major law reviews, legal newspapers, specialty publications, 
bar association journals and international legal journals.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: This includes a large number of American journals in addition to journals from other countries, including Australia.
text_raw:
This includes a large number 
of American journals in addition to journals from other countries, including Australia.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The Advanced Search feature allows Boolean searching for articles on a topic, with results sorted by content type, including academic journals, magazines, news, etc. Articles are also classified by subject.
text_raw:

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Open-access repositories provide a free digital archive (subject to copyright) of the scholarly output of universities and other research institutions.
text_raw:
Open-access repositories provide a free digital archive (subject to copyright) of 
the scholarly output of universities and other research institutions.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: They have become another important option for accessing journal articles and other secondary sources of law.
text_raw:
They have become 
another important option for accessing journal articles and other secondary sources of 
law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Most universities have their own repository to showcase the work of their academics and higher degree research students.
text_raw:
Most universities have their own repository to showcase the work of their academics 
and higher degree research students.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The most significant international repository for law is the Legal Scholarship Network (LSN) (F), a division of the Social Science Research Network (SSRN).
text_raw:
The most significant international repository for law 
is the Legal Scholarship Network (LSN) (F), a division of the Social Science Research Network 
(SSRN).

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Law schools and academics can upload articles and other research papers onto the repository, often prior to commercial publication.
text_raw:
Law schools and academics can upload articles and other research papers onto 
the repository, often prior to commercial publication.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It is important to note that while a large amount of articles on LSN are freely available in full text, publishers and academic institutions do have the option to charge a fee for researchers to download articles.
text_raw:
It is important to note that while a 
large amount of articles on LSN are freely available in full text, publishers and academic 
institutions do have the option to charge a fee for researchers to download articles.

Google (F) is often the first port of call for researchers, in all disciplines, all over the 
world.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It is quick and easy to use and has the capacity to provide relevant results with a minimum of effort.
text_raw:
It is quick and easy to use and has the capacity to provide relevant results with 
a minimum of effort.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: However, researchers need to check for themselves whether the information they have found is current and authoritative.

However, researchers need to check for themselves whether the 
information they have found is current and authoritative.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: It also needs to be recognised that only publicly accessible documents (as opposed to subscription-based material on databases) can be retrieved via Google.

It also needs to be recognised 
that only publicly accessible documents (as opposed to subscription-based material on 
databases) can be retrieved via Google.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Google Scholar (F) is a more useful option than Google because it focuses on finding scholarly information.
text_raw:
Google Scholar (F) is a more useful option than 
Google because it focuses on finding scholarly information.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES

via open-access sites will be located and it is sometimes possible for law students to link

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Other sources of commentary A traditional source of important commentary about the law has come from printed loose-leaf services.
text_raw:
Other sources of commentary
A traditional source of important commentary about the law has come from printed 
loose-leaf services.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: As the name suggests, these services are ringbinder volumes of loose pages.
text_raw:
As the name suggests, these services are ringbinder volumes of loose 
pages.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: A loose-leaf publication has the advantage over a traditional book in that it can easily be kept up to date whenever there is a change to the law by inserting new pages and removing out of date pages as required.
text_raw:
A loose-leaf publication has the advantage over a traditional book in that it can 
easily be kept up to date whenever there is a change to the law by inserting new pages and 
removing out of date pages as required.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: However, these services are now more frequently accessed online and are often referred to in this format simply as ‘commentary’.
text_raw:
However, these services are now more frequently 
accessed online and are often referred to in this format simply as ‘commentary’.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: They provide summaries of relevant case law and legislation on specific legal topics and also provide updates on changes to the law.
text_raw:
They 
provide summaries of relevant case law and legislation on specific legal topics and also 
provide updates on changes to the law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The main pathway for accessing this type of commentary is via the three online platforms:
text_raw:
The main pathway for accessing this type of 
commentary is via the three online platforms:

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Lexis Advance, Westlaw AU and CCH IntelliConnect.
text_raw:
Lexis Advance, Westlaw AU and CCH 
IntelliConnect.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: The collection of commentary on CCH IntelliConnect is particularly useful for commercial law and taxation law.
text_raw:
The collection of commentary on CCH IntelliConnect is particularly useful 
for commercial law and taxation law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Other important sources of commentary include law reform commission publications and parliamentary reports.
text_raw:
Other important sources of commentary include law reform commission publications 
and parliamentary reports.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Law reform commissions conduct inquiries into existing laws on behalf of governments and make recommendations for reform.
text_raw:
Law reform commissions conduct inquiries into existing laws 
on behalf of governments and make recommendations for reform.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Discussion papers and reports from the Australian Law Reform Commission and the various state commissions are available from their respective websites as well as on AustLII.
text_raw:
Discussion papers and 
reports from the Australian Law Reform Commission and the various state commissions 
are available from their respective websites as well as on AustLII.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: Parliamentary reports are documents presented to Parliament on a variety of matters.
text_raw:
Parliamentary reports are 
documents presented to Parliament on a variety of matters.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: They include White Papers (statements of current or intended government policy), Parliamentary Committee Reports (which examine proposed laws or other issues in more detail than is possible during parliamentary debates) and Royal Commission and Commission of Inquiry Reports.
text_raw:
They include White Papers 
(statements of current or intended government policy), Parliamentary Committee Reports 
(which examine proposed laws or other issues in more detail than is possible during 
parliamentary debates) and Royal Commission and Commission of Inquiry Reports.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 17 SEARCHing foR SEC ond ARy SouRCES
text: These sources can all be accessed via the parliamentary websites for each jurisdiction.

text: 508 LAYING DOWN THE LAW Introduction The ability to find cases and research case law remains an essential skill for a lawyer.
text_raw:
508
LAYING DOWN THE LAW
Introduction
The ability to find cases and research case law remains an essential skill for a lawyer.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: Although legislation has become the principle source of law in Australia today, the need to interpret the words and expressions in legislation generates considerable case law.
text_raw:
Although legislation has become the principle source of law in Australia today, the need 
to interpret the words and expressions in legislation generates considerable case law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: As Murray Gleeson AC, 11 th Chief Justice of the High Court of Australia, said: ‘Most of the work of modern courts consists of applying and, where necessary, interpreting Acts of Parliament.’2 Also, for some areas of the law, such as criminal law, contracts, torts, administrative law and constitutional law, case law is still the predominant source of law.
text_raw:
As Murray Gleeson AC, 11 th Chief Justice of the High Court of Australia, said: ‘Most 
of the work of modern courts consists of applying and, where necessary, interpreting 
Acts of Parliament.’2 Also, for some areas of the law, such as criminal law, contracts, torts, 
administrative law and constitutional law, case law is still the predominant source of law.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: This chapter provides you with strategies and skills to research case law effectively.
text_raw: This chapter provides you with strategies and skills to research case law effectively.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: These include finding: • case law on a particular subject; • case citations; • full text judgments; • judicial consideration of cases; • cases referring to specific legislation; • cases defining legal words and phrases; and • case notes.

text: Researching case law: key tasks Researching case law often involves undertaking a series of tasks and using a variety of research tools.

Researching case law often involves undertaking a series of tasks and using a variety

text: However, it is important to realise that these will depend on what information you have to start with and the purpose of your research.

However, it is important to realise that these will depend on what 
information you have to start with and the purpose of your research.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: For example, are you just looking for information about a specific case and, if so, do you already have the complete citation for the case or do you only know the name of one of the parties?

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: If so, do you know enough about the topic to start searching for cases straight away or do you need to do some preliminary reading on the topic first?

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: The logical starting point for law students to identify relevant case law on a legal topic is to go to the cases referred to in their lectures and course materials.

topic is to go to the cases referred to in their lectures and course materials.

finDing CASE LAw on A PARTiCULAR SUBJECT
The strategic approach to research starts with an analysis of the facts of the problem, 
as described in Chapter 16.

chapter_title: CHAPTER 18 SEARCHing foR CASE LAw
text: Part of the factual analysis involves a consideration of the subject matter and the relevant legal issue.
